in_sanskrit.name: Master
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Expert, Teacher, Guide
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Master एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, 'Master' refers to a guru or a wise teacher who guides students on the spiritual path. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Guru' meaning 'heavy', symbolizing the weight of knowledge and wisdom bestowed upon the disciple.
